verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a coding-agent platform like Factory, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only related items describe usage metrics and per-developer adoption tracking, which are monitoring features, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
